title: FIDLOCK V-Buckle Magnetic Chin Strap Kit
features: Patented magnetic-mechanical shear fastener snaps securely into place automatically
Effortless single-hand release pull-tab even with heavy winter gauntlet gloves
High-tensile stainless steel locking pawls withstand up to 70 kg pull force
Retrofit strap weave kit compatible with standard 20mm–25mm helmet webbing
description:
Designed to optimize interior helmet ergonomics and temperature regulation, the FIDLOCK V-Buckle Magnetic Chin Strap Kit from FIDLOCK keeps riders dry, focused, and comfortable across grueling saddle stints. Built with Hydrophilic Moisture-Wicking Core with Fast-Evaporating Air-Mesh Outer, it boasts an installation rating of 2.0 / 10 (Retrofit chin-strap webbing weave with double-box stitch security).

Engineered for all-season comfort, the FIDLOCK V-Buckle Magnetic Chin Strap Kit from FIDLOCK delivers exceptional moisture management and skin comfort, shielding riders from biting wind-chill and summer humidity.
